description: This file defines the NationalityDao class responsible for database operations related to 'Nationality' entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, searching, pagination, and validation of nationality data.

classes.name: NationalityDao
classes.description: DAO class for managing Nationality entities, including CRUD, search, pagination, and validation operations.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Saves a Nationality entity to the database.

methods.name: getNationalityList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Nationality entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator object for navigating through Nationality search results.

methods.name: getNationalityCount
methods.description: Counts the number of Nationality entities matching search criteria.

methods.name: getNationalityById
methods.description: Fetches a Nationality entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingNationalityIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing Nationalities from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getNationalityByName
methods.description: Finds a Nationality by its name.

methods.name: deleteNationalities
methods.description: Deletes multiple Nationalities by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks if a Nationality name already exists.
